QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` are both commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h`; "Threading is on only when you enable `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus a backend (`MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` or your own `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros as the switches that gate all locking, which is the substance of the item.
